events.title: Miracle on 34th Street Lighting
events.blurb: Hampden's famous block of over-the-top rowhouse Christmas lights switches on Saturday evening. The lights stay on nightly through New Year's Day.
events.blurbEs: La famosa cuadra de Hampden con casas adosadas cubiertas de luces navideñas se enciende el sábado por la tarde. Las luces siguen encendidas cada noche hasta el Año Nuevo.

events.title: Nutcracker! Magical Christmas Ballet
events.venue: Hippodrome Theatre at the France-Merrick Performing Arts Center
events.blurb: The touring Nutcracker production with large sets and puppetry plays two evening shows at the Hippodrome.
events.blurbEs: La producción itinerante de El Cascanueces, con grandes escenografías y títeres, ofrece dos funciones nocturnas en el Hippodrome.

events.title: A Christmas Carol
events.blurb: Chesapeake Shakespeare Company's annual staging of Dickens' story, set in 19th-century Baltimore, opens its run this weekend.
events.blurbEs: La puesta anual de Chesapeake Shakespeare Company del cuento de Dickens, ambientada en el Baltimore del siglo XIX, comienza su temporada este fin de semana.

events.title: The Polar Express Train Ride
events.blurb: A short holiday train ride based on the book, with pre-show activities. Bronze tickets start at $50 for kids and $60 for adults; enter through the North Car Shop off Arlington Street.
events.blurbEs: Un breve paseo en tren navideño basado en el libro, con actividades previas. Los boletos Bronze empiezan en $50 para niños y $60 para adultos; la entrada es por el North Car Shop en Arlington Street.
events.getThere: Event parking at 1100 James St (enter on Arlington St); accessible drop-off at the top of the hill on Arlington St.

events.title: Kindred The Family Soul
events.blurb: The Philadelphia neo-soul husband-and-wife duo plays the Harbor East jazz club and restaurant on Friday and Saturday evenings.
events.blurbEs: El dúo de neo-soul de Filadelfia, formado por un matrimonio, se presenta en el club de jazz y restaurante de Harbor East el viernes y el sábado por la noche.
